assessments.reasoning: Printed pp. 44–45 describe a class variable as shared state whose value is independent of the instance executing a referencing method. Printed pp. 47–48 contrast the SalesTaxRate class binding with the named FinancialConstants pool and the global dictionary.

challenge.method: Test whether the wording requires exclusive visibility by reading inherited access on printed p. 58 and the metaclass qualification on printed p. 84.
challenge.results: A class variable is the same binding for the declaring class’s direct instances. The later passages allow access through inheritance and class methods in relevant scopes, which stays outside the direct-instance statement.

limitations: The result covers sharing by direct instances. Visibility across subclasses, class methods, general pools, and globals requires its own scope.
Direct documentary review of the 1983 edition. No Smalltalk runtime was used.
